verdict.rationale: CockroachDB documents a native VECTOR type and vector indexes supporting efficient approximate nearest neighbor (ANN) search on high-dimensional columns, compatible with the pgvector extension, meaning developers can store embeddings and run similarity search directly in CockroachDB without a separate vector DB. Missing for 10: hands-on/independent corroboration of vector search performance or real-world usage reports, and no community discussion validating this feature in practice.
